summary: Phase S2 passes final API/package review at baseline e8d317b7: all previously private core, planner, and SRS capabilities remain available through supported root or subpath imports, every manifest declaration/runtime target exists and loads, and the breaking SRS contract is identified as srs.contract.v2.

Runtime contracts and declarations are usable without those documents, so this remains Phase S4 governance/documentation work rather than a Phase S2 API blocker.

The e8d317b7 delta adds no public declarations, and all newly introduced Phase S2 integration APIs have JSDoc and are consumable; normalize the older declarations in Phase S4.

S2-API-006 [low]: The Phase S1 exact export-key snapshot is stale because remediation intentionally adds valid ./types, ./schemas, ./placement, planner, proficiency, calibration, evaluation, and session subpaths. All added targets now exist and load; update the historical exact-key assertion without removing the production exports.
